name: omnifetch
description: OMNIFETCH — downloader e conversor universal de vídeos, 100% local

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix web --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
